trigger_condition: path segment has malformed percent-encoding (e.g. lone/invalid % sequence)
guard_snippet: try { return decodeURIComponent(segment); } catch { return segment; }
potential_consequence: decodeURIComponent throws, caught by outer try/catch, so an otherwise-valid remote silently returns undefined instead of a usable name

location: src/utils/processes.ts:53-72 (replaces old regex at former processes.ts:400-402)
trigger_condition: git remote is a bare filesystem path (e.g. '/home/user/repo.git' or relative '../repo.git') with no scheme:// and no user@host: form
guard_snippet: add a fallback branch: const pathMatch = withoutGitSuffix.match(/([^/]+)\/([^/]+)$/); if (pathMatch) return `${pathMatch[1]}/${pathMatch[2]}`;
potential_consequence: old generic regex returned a best-effort owner/repo for local/filesystem remotes; new parser requires scheme or scp syntax so these now return undefined, losing repo attribution in telemetry/metrics consumers of detectGitRemoteRepo

trigger_condition: remote URL ends in uppercase or mixed-case '.GIT' instead of lowercase '.git'
